firstPlayerRule: Each player draws one tile from the mixed, face-down tiles. Whoever draws the highest number goes first. Return those tiles and mix them again before dealing the racks.
houseFallback: If a joker is drawn, replace it with a numbered tile. Players tied for the highest number draw again until one has the highest number.
